<thought>The spectra are consistent with a monosubstituted benzene bearing a carbonyl group and an OH. The 1H NMR shows only the five aromatic protons of a phenyl ring, the 13C NMR shows six aromatic carbons plus a carbonyl carbon (~168 ppm), and the IR displays a carbonyl stretch near 1740 cm⁻¹ together with broad O‑H bands, matching benzoic acid (C₇H₆O₂). The SMILES for benzoic acid is “O=C(O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
